# Frozen deadline vectors dumped from inside dcrd's peer package at
# master 452c1a6c by peer/export_deadline_dcroxide_test.go
# (TestExportDeadlineVectors).  Master's pendingDeadlines replaced
# release-v2.1.5's single command-keyed table with pendingData keyed
# by wire.InvVect plus pendingCmds keyed by command, so these rows
# supersede the old deadline|<cmd>|<expected> rows in peer_vectors.txt.

# clearmix|<label>|<cmd>|<mix hash>|<pendingData>|<pendingCmds>
# burst|<label>|<pre-armed>|<requested>|<after>|<projected>|<disconnected>
# check|<label>|<checkDeadlines error or ->
# reason|<inv type>|<checkDeadlines error>
